outfit.reason: This slim-fit blazer with a soft drape is perfect for layering. Its sophisticated 'COAL GREY' color adds a polished touch while remaining comfortable for a museum setting and offers warmth for a potentially chilly San Francisco morning.

The 'BRIGHT WHITE' Contour Crew T-shirt offers a clean, comfortable, and versatile base layer with a second-skin feel. Its double-layer fabric provides a supportive fit, ideal for extended wear while exploring the museum.

These high-rise, wide-leg trousers in 'BLACK' are both stylish and incredibly comfortable, made with a Japanese crepe fabric that is low-wrinkle and has a breezy drape. They offer ease of movement for walking around the museum and can be dressed up or down.

accessories_recommend: Pair this outfit with comfortable yet chic loafers or elegant ballet flats. A medium-sized crossbody bag will keep your essentials secure while allowing you to keep your hands free. Add delicate jewelry, such as simple stud earrings or a minimalist pendant necklace. A lightweight silk scarf can introduce a pop of color or pattern and offer additional warmth if needed.
